params.name: card_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the card.

items.docs: This API operation moves a project card to a different position within the same column or to a different column entirely within a GitHub project board. When making a POST request to /projects/columns/cards/{card_id}/moves, you specify the card_id of the card you want to relocate and provide parameters in the request body to define the new position, such as the target column_id and the desired position relative to other cards (top, bottom, or after a specific card). params.name: column_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the column.

items.docs: This API endpoint allows you to change the position of a project column within a GitHub project board by sending a POST request to /projects/columns/{column_id}/moves. You must specify the column_id in the URL path and provide the desired position in the request body, either as an absolute position using the "position" parameter (e.g., "first", "last", or a specific index) or relative to another column.
